title: T06 — service/galling qualification
facts: Repeated dry austenitic-stainless threaded service is a galling risk and is not accepted as the production process.
The exact anti-galling method must be compatible with the contamination/cleanliness rules of the assembly.

qualification_candidate.note: 50 cycles remains an engineering qualification candidate until the service-life requirement is formally released.

process_options_to_select: controlled compatible thread lubricant on non-wetted thread surfaces
qualified coated/plated stainless service fastener where lubricant is prohibited
replaceable J2 clamp screws after defined service interval
acceptance: No thread pickup requiring P003/P006 repair.
Leak acceptance passes after final cycle.
next: Select one production anti-galling route after T05 preload/torque basis is known.
